chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad from Mu'alla ibn Muhammad from Al-Washa from Hammad ibn 'Uthman from Yaqoub ibn Salim who said:

I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about a man who does not have water with him, and the water is on the right of the road and the left, a couple of stone's throws away or approximately that. He (peace be upon him) said: 'I do not order him to endanger himself, so that a thief or a predator might present himself to him.'

key_terms.غَلْوَتَيْنِ: A distance equivalent to two throws of a stone, used here to denote a short but not immediate distance.
key_terms.يُغَرِّرَ بِنَفْسِهِ: To endanger oneself or expose oneself to risk.

ai.seo_question: When is it permissible to perform Tayammum instead of using water for purification if water is nearby but not immediately accessible?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies that the obligation to use water for wudu or ghusl is suspended if retrieving it entails a tangible risk to one's safety, such as exposure to thieves or wild animals. This ruling exemplifies the principle of 'la darar wa la dirar' (no harm) within Shia jurisprudence, prioritizing the preservation of life and security over the strict performance of ritual purity when the two conflict.

en.hubeali: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moalla Bin Muhammad, from Al Washa, from Hammad Bin Usman, from Yaqoub Bin Salim who said,

‘I asked Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> about a man who does not happen to have water with him, and the water is on the right of the road and the left, a couple of stone’s throw away or approximately that. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘I<sup>asws</sup> do not order him that he should endanger himself, so a thief would present himself or a predator’.
en.sarwar: 8. Af-Husayn ibn Muhammad has narrated from Mu‘alla’ ibn Muhammad from ai-Washsha’ from Hammad ibn ‘Uthman from Ya’qub ibn Salim who has said the following:

“I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about a man who does not have any water (for Wudu’) during a journey, but there is water on the right or left side of the road at a distance of once or twice throwing of an arrow or so. He (the Imam) said, ‘I do not command him to mislead himself and then be endangered by the beasts or thieves.’”
